title: Phylogeny shapes BGC content and prophage dynamics in Virgibacillus: analysis code
description: Analysis code for a comparative genomic study of the 138 publicly available isolate genomes deposited under the name Virgibacillus: GTDB reclassification, clone-group dereplication, BGC prediction and gene cluster families, tests of phylogenetic structure in cluster content, ancestral state reconstruction, the pangenome of GTDB Virgibacillus, and prophage detection and prophage-host divergence. Scripts are grouped by pipeline step and reproduce every table and figure in the article.
